name: @domily/next-codec-toon
description: Experimental TOON source codec for Domily Next PageSpec documents

scripts.build: rm -rf ./lib && bun build ./src/index.ts --bundle --outdir ./lib --target browser --format esm --external @domily/next/codec --external @domily/next/pagespec --external @toon-format/toon && tsc -b ./tsconfig.types.json --force
